name: Hambulo Soseol Sseuji Mabsida
source:
"No Random Novels" is a Visual Novel-style BL game that tells the story of writer Taeram who is thrown into a fantasy BL novel he wrote.

The player becomes the main character "Taeram" and can enjoy the journey with him.
Only your choice can change his future.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2144530]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《别再随便写小说了》是一款视觉小说风格的BL游戏，讲述小说家Taeram被扔进自己创作的一本奇幻BL小说中的故事。

玩家将扮演主角Taeram，和他一同踏上旅程。
只有你的选择能够改变他的未来。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2144530]Steam[/url]]
